2607.12829.title: Accelerating Masked Diffusion Large Language Models: A Survey of Efficient Inference Techniques
2607.12829.paper_summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a theoretical advantage in parallel generation over standard autoregressive models. However, parallel generation alone does not guarantee practical speedups. Realizing this efficiency requires specialized inference mechanisms, such as diffusion-aware caching and reuse. Consequently, as inference efficiency becomes a prerequisite for practical deployment, recent research has actively explored acceleration techniques across algorithms, architectures, and systems. However, rigorous comparisons remain difficult, as end-to-end latency stems from intricate trade-offs between algorithmic, architectural, and system-level factors that are often conflated in existing benchmarks. In this survey, we introduce a unified latency decomposition framework for dLLMs to disentangle these factors and analyze their impact on inference speed in real deployments. Guided by this framework, we categorize acceleration techniques along three axes covering algorithmic innovations, architectural and system optimizations, and inference-time scaling. Finally, we provide guidelines for reproducible benchmarking and highlight open challenges for realizing the full potential of parallel generation.
2607.12829.paper_summary_zh: 擴散大型語言模型（dLLMs）在平行生成方面相較於標準自回歸模型具有理論上的優勢。<lb/>然而，僅僅依靠平行生成並不保證實際的加速。<lb/>實現這種效率需要專門的推理機制，例如擴散感知緩存和重用。<lb/>因此，隨著推理效率成為實際部署的前提，最近的研究積極探索了跨算法、架構和系統的加速技術。<lb/>然而，嚴謹的比較仍然困難，因為端到端的延遲源於算法、架構和系統層面因素之間錯綜複雜的權衡，而這些因素在現有基準中往往被混淆。<lb/>在這項調查中，我們引入了一個統一的延遲分解框架，用於dLLMs，以理清這些因素並分析它們對實際部署中推理速度的影響。<lb/>根據這個框架，我們將加速技術沿著三個軸進行分類，涵蓋算法創新、架構和系統優化，以及推理時間的擴展。<lb/>最後，我們提供可重複基準測試的指導方針，並強調實現平行生成全部潛力的開放挑戰。
